prompt: The stemplot shows the ages of the $10$ players on a recreational soccer team (key: $2|3$ means $23$ years). How many players are $23$ or older?
hint: In a stemplot the stem is the tens digit and each leaf is the ones digit of one player. Where in the plot does the age $23$ sit?

hints.text: In a stemplot the stem is the tens digit and each leaf is the ones digit of one player. Where in the plot does the age $23$ sit?
Written out, the ages are $12, 15, 18, 20, 23, 23, 27, 31, 34, 40$. Count every age from the first $23$ to the end of the list, and remember that $23$ itself is included.
The ages $23, 23, 27, 31, 34, 40$ qualify, so $6$ players are $23$ or older.

explanation: Read the plot row by row to recover the ages: stem $1$ gives $12, 15, 18$; stem $2$ gives $20, 23, 23, 27$; stem $3$ gives $31, 34$; stem $4$ gives $40$.
"$23$ or older" includes $23$ itself, so both leaves of $3$ on stem $2$ count, along with everything after them.
The ages that qualify are $23, 23, 27, 31, 34, 40$, which is $6$ players.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count the ones you skip
steps: There are 10 leaves in all, so $10 - 4 = 6$ players are 23 or older.
